title: Interrupted idle Wither stroll cancels navigation
description: After detecting horizontal idle-flight movement, force Invul200 and observe32 ticks. Horizontal motion must settle, matching vanilla RandomStrollGoal.stop.
notes: Specialized regression: summon one target-free Wither at15.5 84 15.5 with Health100,Silent1,NoGravity1,Invul0; set movement_speed and flying_speed to0.5. Step2 ticks at a time (max1200) until horizontal displacement in one sample exceeds0.02; require route detection before running steps. Include the position at interruption. Tail path length over the final12 of32 ticks must be <0.1 blocks. Repeat twice with ordinary active-flight and initially-Invul200 controls. Random route and detection timing differ across servers. Forced midlife invulnerability is a test stimulus, not natural construction. No rendered-client or whole-fight proof.
